## Strongest new result: a genuine noise-to-computation connection

The previous checkpoint had a local circuit-error bridge. This one receives it into an actual disjoint, recursively scheduled computation-code construction. Its joint inclusive complete-norm law yields

`x_(j+1) <= binom(A,s) x_j^s (1+x_j)^(A-s)`

and doubly exponential suppression in concatenation level for a sufficiently small fixed physical strength. A common coherent decoder handles two-sided operator histories, including signed bath coefficients; a trace-defect argument gives reduced logical error at most twice the bad-map norm. The contribution is the receiving of the declared broader continuous-noise model, rather than the invention of fault tolerance.

Finite preparation is now actually priced. Replacing an isolated finite intended gate by its exact proof target changes local strength to `x+delta`. A supplied reset generator has finite residual `delta_R <= 2 exp(-kappa tau_R)`, uniformly for dirty entangled ancillary targets. Choose finite reset duration first, then a sufficiently small positive incident-noise tolerance for the actual duration. This avoids assuming freshly pure ancillas. It still requires an available replacement primitive, gate library, timing and connectivity.

[Aharonov–Ben-Or](https://arxiv.org/html/quant-ph/9906129) supply computation codes, arbitrary-input correction, a nested disjoint rectangle hierarchy and reliable scheduled computation. Their basic general-noise model factors locations; the new shared-bath receiving is additional work. [Aliferis–Gottesman–Preskill, section 11](https://arxiv.org/html/quant-ph/0504218) already treat non-Markovian shared-bath noise with inclusive fault sums, using an operator-amplitude norm and overlap handling. Dots cannot import those numerical thresholds or normalization arguments unchanged. Its selected disjoint hierarchy avoids needing an overlapping-rectangle theorem for this existence result. Correlated-noise tolerance itself is established ancestry, not a new capability label.

This is a meaningful foundational connection: the new noise law can support a known powerful computational architecture. It does not establish that available laboratory hardware meets its threshold or supplies its controls, nor establish historical novelty or an advantage over conventional fault tolerance.
